title: P2LRN Legacy Tin Can Package Profile
description: Preserves legacy tincan.xml launch packages. This is deliberately distinct from the xAPI statement protocol itself.
rules: A tincan.xml package MUST NOT be mislabeled as the xAPI specification itself.
Original launch metadata SHOULD be preserved even when identifiers are placeholders or are not valid absolute URIs.
Legacy package launch data MUST NOT weaken P2LRN URL/network safety rules during validation.
